requirements from staffing and space records: downtown Los Angeles or environs, proximity to existing or planned Metro rail, parking, a boardroom of at least 1,500 square feet, compliant and secured-server space at occupancy, and suitable low-voltage infrastructure; require Energy Star labeling within one year, with LEED preferred."},{"requirement_id":"R2","evidence":"Draft building-owner and developer solicitation materials stating location, floor-area and floorplate needs, operational requirements, completion schedule, and financial requirements."},{"requirement_id":"R3","evidence":"Conduct pre-proposal conferences and answer inquiries, market the opportunity, initially assess responses and building compliance, and arrange site tours for CPA staff and design consultants."},{"requirement_id":"R4","evidence":"Evaluate proposals and perform due diligence, establish lease and move-in improvement costs, and recommend a shortlist of facilities."},{"requirement_id":"R5","evidence":"Obtain CPA pre-approval of negotiating strategies, negotiate incentives and concessions, and document negotiations, terms, and letters of intent."},{"requirement_id":"R6","evidence":"Present the recommended transaction and terms for CPA approval, supporting a governing-committee presentation if needed."},{"requirement_id":"R7","evidence":"Prepare or coordinate lease documentation to finalize the approved transaction."}],"plan":[{"requirement_id":"R1","owner":"blocked_private_input","prerequisite_status":"unverified","review_required":true,"proposed_artifact":"Requirements-validation checklist tied to staffing, space, transit, parking, boardroom, server, and sustainability criteria."},{"requirement_id":"R2","owner":"agent_draft","prerequisite_status":"unverified","review_required":true,"proposed_artifact":"Draft solicitation outline for owners/developers covering location, area, floorplate, operations, schedule, and financial inputs."},{"requirement_id":"R3","owner":"human_required","prerequisite_status":"unverified","review_required":true,"proposed_artifact":"Conference, inquiry, outreach, response-screening, and site-tour scoping workflow with required human decision points."},{"requirement_id":"R4","owner":"human_required","prerequisite_status":"unverified","review_required":true,"proposed_artifact":"Proposal evaluation and due-diligence framework with cost-estimate fields and shortlist recommendation placeholders."},{"requirement_id":"R5","owner":"human_required","prerequisite_status":"unverified","review_required":true,"proposed_artifact":"Negotiation approval and LOI documentation checklist noting CPA pre-approval and concession-tracking dependencies."},{"requirement_id":"R6","owner":"human_required","prerequisite_status":"unverified","review_required":true,"proposed_artifact":"Transaction recommendation memo template and optional governing-committee presentation outline for review."},{"requirement_id":"R7","owner":"human_required","prerequisite_status":"unverified","review_required":true,"proposed_artifact":"Lease-document coordination scope note identifying approval gates, counsel review, and execution prerequisites."}],"report":{"source_url":"https://files.cleanpoweralliance.org/uploads/2019/08/CPA-RFP-Real-Estate-Brokerage-Services_8.5.2019-001.pdf","requirement_ids":["R1","R2","R3","R4","R5","R6","R7"],"exclusions":["Private staffing plans, financial constraints, property proposals, due-diligence evidence, and negotiating authority were not supplied; final advice and commitments require the licensed broker and CPA approvals.","Relocation management and tenant-improvement design, architecture or construction-management services are optional under separately negotiated agreements, not automatic baseline work.","A qualifying shared boardroom or tenant improvement may meet the boardroom requirement; LEED certification is preferred, not mandatory. No non-commission fee is assumed.","Experimental boundary: no buyer contact, bid submission, spending, private-system access, or autonomous delivery of the engagement."],"delivery_status":"not_executed","summary":"Scope covers public-request brokerage support for Los Angeles office procurement, from requirement confirmation through lease documentation. Key evidence and authorities remain missing, including staffing/space records, proposals, due diligence, financial inputs, and negotiation approvals, so this packet is scoping only."}}
